[Sign up](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiVmliZSBDaGVjazogT3B1cyA0LjjigJRBbnRocm9waWMgU2hvdWxk4oCZdmUgUm91bmRlZCBVcCB0byA1IiwicG9zdF9pZCI6NDI3NywicG9zdF90eXBlIjoicG9zdCIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZXZlcnkudG8vYWNjb3VudCIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjo2fQ==) to get it in your inbox.*     ---     Anthropic is back.  After a year of riding Claude Code into the rest of knowledge work, the lab hit a rough patch: [Opus 4.7](https://every.) was hard to love, and OpenAI’s [Codex desktop app](https://every.) pulled even devoted Claude users from our team to GPT models. Opus 4.8, out today, has us running back—for the model, if not the app around it. It tops our Senior Engineer Benchmark and our writing tests at once, and it’s the first Anthropic release in a year we’d reach for across coding, prose, and everyday work.  The big insights from our testing:   * **Best on senior-engineer coding.** At extra-high effort, Opus 4.8 scored 63 on our Senior Engineer Benchmark, versus 62 for GPT-5.5 and 33.5 for Opus 4.7. At lower effort settings, the score drops significantly. * **The strongest writing model we’ve tested.** Opus 4.8 at high effort scored 79.6, ahead of Sonnet 4.6 (74.5), GPT-5.5 (73), and Opus 4.7 (63), with fewer AI tells than any non-Claude model. * **Best one-shot PowerPoint we’ve seen.** On our Every Consulting Benchmark, Opus 4.8 produced a well-designed deck that told a clear story—something most models still can’t do. * **The model is stronger than the app.** Opus 4.8 is good enough to make us want to live in Claude, but the split between Chat, Code, and Cowork keeps Codex as the better daily harness.   The full [Vibe Check](https://every.) has the benchmark results, Reach Test ratings, pricing, screenshots, and advice on when to reach for Opus 4.8 versus GPT-5.5.
